fib: ______ is one of the important documents of a company.
register of members

______ is the objective of corporate governance.
Corporate accountability
Corporate accountability is the objective of corporate governance.

______ is responsible for the development and maintenance of a formal, rigorous and transparent procedure for making recommendations on appointments and re-appointment of directors to the board of the Company.
nomination committee

The nomination committee is responsible for the development and maintenance of a formal, rigorous and transparent procedure for making recommendations on appointments and re-appointment of directors to the board of the Company.
______ is a formal proposal made directly to the shareholders of a company to buy their shares with cash or share exchange (or other securities) or both cash and shares.
tender offer
A tender offer is a formal proposal made directly to the shareholders of a company to buy their shares with cash or share exchange (or other securities) or both cash and shares.
______ is the acquisition of a controlling interest in a company.
buyout
A buyout is the acquisition of a controlling interest in a company.
______ is responsible for explaining why they have refused to apply any principle of the corporate governance code.
board
The board is responsible for explaining why they have refused to apply any principle of the corporate governance code.
______ are those rights which do not correspond to the general rights of membership available to all shareholders of the same class.
Outsider rights
Outsider rights are those rights which do not correspond to the general rights of membership available to all shareholders of the same class.
______ is one of the mechanisms for doing business, and it should be free to determine how its affairs are to be conducted, including its relationship with third parties.
corporate entity
Summary A corporate entity is one of the mechanisms for doing business, and it should be free to determine how its affairs are to be conducted, including its relationship with third parties.

scheme
A scheme is an offer to acquire control over the shares of the company (App 7 Takeover Code).

committee

The committee is responsible for the formulation of written remuneration policy that should have the aim of attracting and retaining appropriate talent, and for deciding the forms that remuneration should take.

unitary board

winding up order

company constitution
